title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Has Dropped To Over A 3-Month Low
text:
Shutterstock photo
( RTTNews.com ) - Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) gapped open sharply lower Monday morning and has continued to lose ground in early trade. The stock is now down 7.39 at $197.08.
Apple has tumbled to over a 3-month low. The stock is under pressure after a profit warning from supplier Lumentum.
